patches_added.name: Account cleanup
patches_added.description: Adds Remove all reposts, Remove all likes and Clear Favorites to Hushfeed settings > Privacy. Each one takes items off your account one at a time through TikTok's own requests, with a pause between them, and stops on the first error.

patches_added.name: Freeze TikTok's experiments
patches_added.description: Lets you keep the settings TikTok's servers sent it so far. TikTok tests new layouts and features on people by sending new ones all the time, and with this on it ignores them. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, or sort the videos a grid has loaded. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide feed and bottom tabs you don't use, rename the bottom tabs, choose the tab TikTok opens on, stop For You reloading when you tap Home and hold Profile to open your Watch history. Starts off, except holding Home to open Hushfeed settings. Find it in Hushfeed settings > Feed tabs.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox items
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications and TikTok's Main, Requests, Unread and Starred tabs on any account, and a way to rebuild message search. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide Inbox rows you don't use, like message requests, TikTok Shop and the stories row, plus call buttons and suggested replies in chats. Each has its own switch. Also offers search in loaded Activity notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Hide search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the searches TikTok suggests before you type, and can hide the search rewards banner. Your own search history stays. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > App.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count instead of a rounded one, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, and keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Long-press controls
patches_modified.description: Lets a long press on a video like it, open the comments, copy the link, save the sound or the frame on screen, or set a sleep timer, and can give a creator's videos For You's full long-press menu. Starts off. Pick an action in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: Notification controls
patches_modified.description: Lets you turn off new follower notifications and streak reminders, which TikTok has no switch for, or turn off TikTok's notifications altogether. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Inbox.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Remembers the speed you picked for the next video, and lets you set a default speed, add speeds up to 3x to the menu and choose the speed for press and hold. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings page to TikTok, at the top of Settings and privacy. Pressing and holding For You at the top of the feed opens it too. That's where you turn Hushfeed's features on and off. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Controller velocity frame

patches_modified.name: Adda247 Ad Removal
patches_modified.description: Blocks all Google AdMob ads (banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, native, app open and Ad Manager) by neutralizing the Flutter Google Mobile Ads plugin: no ad is ever requested and no ad can ever be shown.

patches_modified.name: Adda247 MoEngage In-App Blocker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the app's own MoEngage in-app promotions (the recurring "recommended for you" nudge with no close button, and full-screen standard in-app messages) by no-oping MoEngage's HTML render chokepoint, so no in-app WebView is ever built or attached. Separate from the Google AdMob block.

patches_modified.name: Free Ad Rewards
patches_modified.description: Every "watch ad" reward is granted instantly — no ad appears, no "failed to load advertisement" popup, and nothing to wait for.

patches_modified.name: Free Store
patches_modified.description: Everything in the shop is free. Tap an item and you get it right away — points, characters and presents — with no Google Play payment screen and nothing charged.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Ad Removal
patches_modified.description: Removes all ads — banner and pop-up ads never show, and the game treats you as ad-free from the start without any repeat purchase pop-ups.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store
patches_modified.description: Everything in the store is free — coins, gems, paints and bundles are added instantly with no Google Play payment.

patches_modified.name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards
patches_modified.description: Rewarded ads pay out instantly — no video plays; the game gives you the reward as if you had watched the whole ad.

patches_modified.name: Free IAP
patches_modified.description: Every store item — gold packs, skins and remove ads — is granted the moment you tap Buy. No Google Play payment sheet ever opens and nothing is charged.

patches_modified.name: Native IAP Patch
patches_modified.description: Fixes the native purchase result so every store purchase (gold packs, skins, remove ads) is granted on device — without depending on the Java bridge handshake.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Removes all ads. Reward videos now give you the prize instantly — no watching needed.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited money (restore save)
patches_modified.description: Loads the unlimited money save into the game the first time you open it.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited money (save bundle)
patches_modified.description: Packs the special save file (unlimited coins & gems, everything unlocked) inside the app.

patches_added.name: Unlock Events
patches_added.description: Unlocks every event (seasonal worlds, event missions and their pop-ups) by disabling the game's internal "IAP cheat" flag check. When a free-IAP patch forges a purchase the game's receipt validator marks the account as a cheater and locks all cheater-restricted events behind an 'Event Restricted' pop-up; this patch makes that check always answer 'not a cheat', so the events open normally.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Instant Rewarded Ads
patches_modified.description: Watch-ad offers grant their reward instantly with no ad. Forced interstitials stay gone.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes forced ads. No more ads between levels, no banners.

patches_modified.name: Swamp Attack 2: Unlimited Currency
patches_modified.description: Never run out of coins, gems or other resources. Buying things never lowers your balance. Note: ignore the coins/diamonds value shown — even if it shows less than the item price, just tap the item and it will be granted.

patches_added.description: Gives 8 custom scenario save slots and unlimited downloads.

patches_added.description: Forces the native engine to report custom scenario slot tier 3 (8 slots, unlimited downloads).

patches_added.description: Auto-claims outbreak trial missions and suppresses outbreak purchase/onboarding popups.

patches_added.description: Unlocks all official scenarios.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Forces Firebase analytics and crash reporting off, ignoring the in-app privacy toggles and their defaults.

patches_modified.name: Hide sign-in banner
patches_modified.description: Removes the orange "Sign in" prompt below the toolbar. The account screen stays reachable from the drawer.

patches_modified.name: Neutralize tamper fork bomb
patches_modified.description: Stops the native anti-tamper response that spawns unbounded threads and crashes the app a few seconds after launch on a repackaged build.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Expert
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Expert tier and disables the PairIP licence check.

patches_added.name: Disable telemetry
patches_added.description: Blocks Segment and Mux events, disables Firebase Analytics after consent updates, denies automatic Crashlytics uploads and selects disabled Datadog setup. SDK initialization, queued Segment events, local metadata, Firebase collection before consent updates, local crash recording and explicit report submission remain; independent Braze and Singular behavior is unchanged.

patches_removed.name: Disable Datadog telemetry setup

patches_removed.name: Disable Firebase analytics after consent initialization
patches_removed.description: Keeps Firebase Analytics collection disabled when consent updates arrive. Collection before the first update remains possible.

patches_removed.name: Disable Mux playback analytics events
patches_removed.description: Drops Mux playback analytics events while retaining player and ad initialization. Local SDK metadata remains.

patches_removed.name: Disable Segment analytics events
patches_removed.description: Blocks new Segment events, identification and screen payloads. SDK initialization and previously queued events remain.

patches_removed.name: Disable automatic Crashlytics uploads
patches_removed.description: Denies automatic crash report uploads. Local crash recording and explicit report submission remain available.

patches_added.name: Hide your own reblogs
patches_added.description: Takes the reblogs you made out of your dashboard and the feeds like it as each page loads. Your blog still shows them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: App font
patches_modified.description: Replaces Tumblr's own font with your phone's font, or a font file you choose in settings. Fonts a post's author picked stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Dark background color
patches_modified.description: Makes the background of Tumblr's Dark Mode palette black, which can save battery on OLED screens, or another dark color you pick when patching. On Android 12 or newer it can follow your wallpaper's colors instead. Blog and tag pages take it too, in place of their own colors. Other palettes stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Turns off Firebase crash reports and Google's analytics collection, and Tumblr's own tracking and ad measurement once it restarts. The Firebase and Google part stays until you patch again without it. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops Tumblr asking Google Play for a newer version and showing Play's update prompt. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Filter activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Hides selected likes, reblogs, replies, follows, mentions, asks and boops from the activity list as pages load. Each switch starts off. Choose them in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Firebase can refuse a patched Tumblr whose request doesn't name Tumblr's original signature, so this sends its fingerprint. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide Blaze prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides the prompts to pay for Blaze, Tumblr's way to promote a post. That covers the Blaze buttons on your blog and dashboard, the nudge after you post, and the Blaze banners. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Tumblr TV
patches_modified.description: Takes the Tumblr TV tab out of the bottom bar, and stops sign-up from sending you there. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide Watch it rows
patches_modified.description: Takes Tumblr TV's Watch it rows and video hub cards out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Takes ad cards and paid Blaze posts out of your dashboard and other feeds, and stops Tumblr asking its ad networks for more. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Tumblr and the ad companies inside it see an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you'd deleted your ad ID in Android. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide blog notification reminders
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you turn on notifications for a blog. Your subscriptions and notification settings stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide filtered posts
patches_modified.description: Takes the posts Tumblr covers with "This post contains filtered content" out of your dashboard, searches and other feeds, so your filtered tags and words hide them completely. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide gift purchase popups
patches_modified.description: Hides the pop-up suggesting you buy a gift for a blog. You can still open gifting yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide hashtags
patches_modified.description: Takes the tags off the bottom of posts in your dashboard, other feeds and Tumblr TV, and keeps the source link. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide note counts
patches_modified.description: Takes the like, reblog and comment counts off the footer under posts, community posts included, and the counts off the top of a post's notes and its tabs. The buttons stay and still work. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide photo posts
patches_modified.description: Takes photo posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with pictures and no video, its reblog trail included, counts as a photo post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide posts with these words
patches_modified.description: Hides posts matching your word list. Choose whether to check current text, the reblog trail, tags or summaries. Allowed words can keep a matching post, but other enabled filters still apply. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide reblogs
patches_modified.description: Takes reblogs out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads, and keeps the posts people made themselves. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested blogs
patches_modified.description: Takes the blogs Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, whether as cards, rows or carousels, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested communities
patches_modified.description: Takes the communities Tumblr suggests you join out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested tags
patches_modified.description: Takes the tags Tumblr suggests you follow out of your dashboard and other feeds, along with their headings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide text posts
patches_modified.description: Takes text posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with no pictures or video, its reblog trail included, counts as a text post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Communities tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Communities tab out of the bottom bar and stops the Communities tips in the post editor. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Explore tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Explore and search button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Follow button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Follow button out of the header of posts from blogs you don't follow yet. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Takes the Notifications button off the bottom bar. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Save button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Save button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, when Tumblr shows one. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the ad-free banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the banner on your dashboard that asks you to pay for Ad-Free Browsing. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the comment button
patches_modified.description: Takes the comment button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the diamond and TumblrMart
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium diamond and the TumblrMart button at the top of your dashboard, Explore and notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide the like button
patches_modified.description: Takes the like button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds, and the reactions off community posts. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reblog button
patches_modified.description: Takes the reblog button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide the share button
patches_modified.description: Takes the share button out of the footer under posts in your dashboard and other feeds. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide unread dots
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread dots and counts on the bottom bar's Dashboard, Communities and Notifications tabs, with a switch for each tab. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide video posts
patches_modified.description: Takes video posts out of your dashboard and other feeds as each page loads. A post with a video anywhere in it, its reblog trail included, counts as a video post. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard, from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the Tumblr icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Line between posts

patches_modified.name: Reorder the bottom bar

patches_modified.name: Reveal allowed mature content

patches_modified.name: Share video links

patches_modified.name: Show mutual markers
patches_modified.description: Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show post timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Skip review prompts

patches_added.name: On-screen Game Log

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Paints the bottom bar pure black in dark mode, so it matches Pinterest's black pages on OLED screens. The comments sheet and a pin's menu can go black too, each with its own switch. Light mode stays as it is. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from sending usage reports, crash reports and ad-tracking data to outside companies, and turns off Google's analytics inside the app. Good if you'd rather share less. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable update nag
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest's pop-ups asking you to update from the Play Store. You can still update Pinterest yourself. Good if the reminders get annoying. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Updates.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds Download board to a board's menu. It saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board, up to 500, and skips ones already in Download history, so you can keep a board without picking pins one at a time. Needs Download pins on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Download pins
patches_modified.description: Adds downloads for a pin, or for several pins you select in a grid. Saves the original image or the highest-quality video Pinterest supplies to your phone. When it saves an image, Pinterest's own Download image row is hidden. Downloads go to the Download folder. Turn on Save in Pinterest's folder to keep them in Pictures/100PINT/Pins with Pinterest's own saves, or use Pick a download folder to choose any folder inside Pictures, DCIM, Download or Documents. Starts off. Copy image puts an image pin's full-size picture on the clipboard, and Share image sends it through Android's share menu. Each has its own switch, also off. Save pins you download also saves a pin you download to your profile, and Download pins you save also downloads a pin you save. Those two start off as well. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: Filter feed
patches_modified.description: Lets you take video pins (photos and GIFs stay) and pins that mention words you mute out of your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and pins you've already saved out of your home feed. Starts off. Set it up in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide Add to collage, Remix collage, Search image and Promote pin in a pin's menu, each with its own switch. Download, share and copy link stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Fix push notifications
patches_modified.description: Lets the patched app sign up for push notifications. Google's Firebase service only signs Pinterest up when the request names Pinterest's original signature, so this sends that signature's fingerprint and changes nothing else in the request. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Notifications.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Lets Google sign-in and push notifications go through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. Pick it only if microG-RE is on your phone. Without microG-RE, Google sign-in and push notifications stop working in the patched app. It brings Spoof signature for Google sign-in along. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI-labeled pins
patches_modified.description: Removes pins that Pinterest labels as made or changed with AI from your home feed, search, related pins and boards. A second switch also takes unlabeled pins whose title or description calls them AI art, or that come from an AI image site. Other AI images still show. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant
patches_modified.description: Removes Pinterest's AI Assistant from search, boards and pins, so you don't get its buttons or its suggestion row. Regular search keeps working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted pins from your home feed, search, related pins and boards, and hides panels that only hold ads. Good for a cleaner feed. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Pinterest sees an empty advertising ID with ad tracking limited, the same as if you deleted your advertising ID in Android. Pinterest also stops keeping its browser ID in Google's Block Store, so a reinstall doesn't bring the old one back. Good for keeping ads from following you. On by default. Turn it off in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Hide closeup buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the buttons on a pin you open, each with its own switch. That covers the back arrow and the visual search (lens) button that float over the picture, the like, comment, share and more buttons under it, the Remix button and the Visit site button. Another switch keeps the lens but drops its glow and the Search image label Pinterest puts on it for your first pins each day. Two more rows draw the red Save button smaller or paint it a color you pick. Your phone's back gesture still leaves the pin, and Search image in the pin menu still works. They all start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Collapses the comments and comment previews under pins. It doesn't change who can comment on your pins. Good for a quieter pin page. A separate switch hides the suggested replies next to the comment box. Both start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the small icon buttons at the end of the top bar. Back buttons, text buttons and account controls stay. Good for a cleaner top bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. The Create and Notifications switches also cover those buttons at the top of Home. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you hide the Create, Notifications and Search buttons in the bottom bar, each with its own switch. Home and Profile stay. Starts off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide save toasts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up Pinterest shows after you save a pin, such as the Saved to your board message or a suggestion to follow the creator. The pin is still saved. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide search history
patches_modified.description: Hides your recent searches on the search screen of this phone. It doesn't delete your account's search history. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide shopping and product pins
patches_modified.description: Hides shoppable pins, shopping stories and featured boards. Good if you want to browse ideas, not products. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide survey prompts
patches_modified.description: Turns down Pinterest's "Got a minute?" survey invite before it pops up, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so the same survey doesn't come back. Advertiser-sponsored polls don't pop up either. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Hide topic suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Ideas you might love row of topic bubbles under pins, without leaving a gap. Comments and related pins stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: HushPinterest settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushPinterest page to Pinterest where you turn features on or off, pause HushPinterest, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Pinterest's settings, or by long-pressing the Pinterest logo at the top of your home feed or Pinterest's app icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep Home feed
patches_modified.description: Keeps your Home feed where you left it when you come back to Pinterest or to the Home tab, instead of loading new pins on its own. Pull down to refresh whenever you want new pins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Long-press download
patches_modified.description: Adds a Download button to the menu you get when you long-press a pin in a grid, the round one and the newer list, so you can save a pin without opening it. Needs Download pins on too. Three more switches take Pinterest's Save, Send or Search image button out of that menu. All start off. Turn them on in HushPinterest settings > Pin actions.

patches_modified.name: No screenshot share menu
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest from popping up sharing suggestions after you take a screenshot. Screenshots still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Open links in your browser
patches_modified.description: Opens a pin's Visit link and profile websites in your web browser. Pinterest links and sign-in work as before. Good if you prefer your own browser. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Links.

patches_modified.name: Original-quality images
patches_modified.description: Loads the original image for each pin and in collages, instead of the large size. Pictures look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Quiet email reminders
patches_modified.description: Dismisses the optional reminder to confirm your email. Account checks and sign-in still work as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Pinterest, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Show posted date
patches_modified.description: Shows the day a pin was posted under its title when you open it. Pinterest sends that date with every pin but never shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushPinterest settings > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Pinterest's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Strip link tracking
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Pinterest. The link still goes to the same place. Its Plain pin links switch also turns short pin.it links into the pin's own pinterest.com link, so they don't show who shared them. Strip link tracking is on by default and Plain pin links starts off. Both are in HushPinterest settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: System share sheet

patches_added.name: Karaoke
patches_added.description: Turns the lead vocal down so you can sing over the song, with a Karaoke control at the bottom right of the lyrics. Ported from the vocal remover in Auris by OreoMuncher45, a fork of BitChord. Choose the filter or on-device separation model. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Audio and video switch
patches_modified.description: Adds a song and video switch to the top of the player, as in YouTube Music: one tap plays a song's music video, or the song again, in the same place in the queue. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Battery saver
patches_modified.description: Lets the phone's audio chip decode songs, so long listens use less battery. BitChord's effects don't run on songs played this way. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: DJ mode
patches_modified.description: Orders upcoming tracks by measured key and tempo. Choose Steady, Build up or Wind down, use longer AutoMix blends for compatible keys, or save the order to a local playlist. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.
patches_modified.previous_description: Picks the next song in the queue for a neighbouring key and a close tempo. Keys and tempos are learned as songs play. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Equaliser per output
patches_modified.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Headphone correction
patches_modified.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches_modified.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

patches_modified.name: JamesDSP
patches_modified.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches_modified.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Loudness level
patches_modified.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches_modified.description: Adds signed-out playlist links, editable device copies, queue saving, native file import and reviewed two-way Spotify/YouTube Music playlist sync. Keeps files and streams together with full source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Per-download quality
patches_modified.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Pitch control
patches_modified.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Play alongside other apps
patches_modified.description: Keeps the music playing when another app plays sound, such as a reel or a video, instead of pausing. Calls still pause it. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches_modified.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches_modified.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Smart downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads the songs you play most, on Wi-Fi, so they're there without a signal. Uses BitChord's listening statistics and its Download quality; songs you delete aren't downloaded again. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Steady playback
patches_modified.description: Reads further ahead, through the rest of the song and into the next ones, with separate limits for Wi-Fi and mobile data, and waits through a lost signal instead of stopping. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Streamseek previews
patches_modified.description: Preview explicitly selected Soulseek audio while it transfers: FLAC, WAV/AIFF, ALAC, APE, WavPack, TTA/TAK, WMA Lossless and DSD, plus MP3. A dedicated on-device FFmpeg decoder feeds Media3. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches_modified.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Android 8 or newer.

patches_modified.description: Remembers BitChord's equaliser for each output (speaker, wired, each Bluetooth device) and puts it back when that output is used; shares settings as codes. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Headphone correction
patches_modified.description: Flattens your headphones' sound with a measured profile, one per output, from AutoEq's thousands of models or pasted in. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Install as Bitchord+
patches_modified.description: Installs next to your regular BitChord as Bitchord+, or under a name you choose.

patches_modified.name: JamesDSP
patches_modified.description: Hands BitChord's audio to JamesDSP, the open-source effect engine: open it from BitChord, announce the audio session again and let it take over the effects. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Lossless addons over Bluetooth
patches_modified.description: Keeps addons marked lossless in use over Bluetooth, where BitChord normally skips them. Lossless-first, as in Auris by OreoMuncher45. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Loudness level
patches_modified.description: Sets how loud loudness normalisation plays songs, from -23 to -8 LUFS instead of -14. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches_modified.description: Adds signed-out playlist links, editable device copies, queue saving, native file import and reviewed two-way Spotify/YouTube Music playlist sync. Keeps files and streams together with full source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Per-download quality
patches_modified.description: Asks which quality to download each song in: Standard, High or Lossless. An album is asked about once. From Stash by Rawnald Clark. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Pitch control
patches_modified.description: Moves the key up or down by up to 12 semitones without changing the speed. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Play alongside other apps
patches_modified.description: Keeps the music playing when another app plays sound, such as a reel or a video, instead of pausing. Calls still pause it. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Sign in with MicroG
patches_modified.description: Offers to sign in to YouTube Music with an account that's already in MicroG RE, instead of Google's sign-in page.

patches_modified.name: Sleep timer fade-out
patches_modified.description: Fades the song out before the sleep timer pauses it, and fades the end of the last song with the timer's "After this song" option. From Prism by Yigder. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Smart downloads
patches_modified.description: Downloads the songs you play most, on Wi-Fi, so they're there without a signal. Uses BitChord's listening statistics and its Download quality; songs you delete aren't downloaded again. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Steady playback
patches_modified.description: Reads further ahead, through the rest of the song and into the next ones, with separate limits for Wi-Fi and mobile data, and waits through a lost signal instead of stopping. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_modified.name: Streamseek previews
patches_modified.description: Preview explicitly selected Soulseek audio while it transfers: FLAC, WAV/AIFF, ALAC, APE, WavPack, TTA/TAK, WMA Lossless and DSD, plus MP3. A dedicated on-device FFmpeg decoder feeds Media3. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches_modified.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches_modified.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Telegram copies require the optional Telegram patch and your private main channel. Debrid services use your API keys. Live Soulseek playback stays disabled. Settings are in Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Unofficial Telegram music
patches_modified.description: Search and play audio from your own Telegram channels, right on your phone. Android 8 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Prevents product and ad videos from autoplaying.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.
patches_modified.previous_description: Prevents product and ad videos from autoplaying.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto-update
patches_modified.description: Disables automatic app update checks, the blocking update screen, and the proxy sponsor channel insertion.
patches_modified.previous_description: Disables automatic app update checks in Telegram Plus.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Hides your typing indicator from other users in all chats.
patches_modified.previous_description: Prevents typing status from being sent in Telegram Plus.

patches_modified.name: Remove ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored messages and video ads from all chats and channels.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes Plus banner ads, native ads, Telegram sponsored messages, and video ads.

patches_added.name: Add CLEO script support
patches_added.description: Adds CLEO Android 2.0.1, which runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu. Installs 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/; the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run, so delete the ones you don't want.

patches_added.name: Add PS2 graphics
patches_added.description: Adds SkyGfx: PS2 colours and timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas and post effects, the PC graphics settings the phone menu hides (draw distance, shadows, anti-aliasing and more) and AMD FSR 1 upscaling.

patches_added.name: Add blowing litter
patches_added.description: Adds Rubbish-DE by H4V3NART: loose litter on the streets that blows around when vehicles pass. Builds its model pak from the game's own files at the first start, so no game files are shipped.

patches_added.name: Add extra map props
patches_added.description: Adds about 16,000 map props from Project Props 4 by user-grinch. Downloads the placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching, so it needs internet.

patches_added.name: Add mod menu
patches_added.description: Adds ModMenu, an in-game menu that changes the settings of the other mods while playing.

patches_added.name: Fix prop physics
patches_added.description: Adds GTA Prop Fix, which restores the original game's physics for knocked-over props: lamp posts, traffic lights, signs, bins and hydrants fall and roll with world and car collision instead of DE's physics, and broken pieces land on the ground instead of falling through the map.

patches_added.name: Load pak mods
patches_added.description: Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts, above the game's own paks, so PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is. Copy the .pak files there and restart the game.

patches_added.name: Play loading screen music
patches_added.description: Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.

patches_removed.name: CLEO
patches_removed.description: CLEO Android 2.0.1: runs CLEO scripts with the swipe-down CLEO menu, script text and touch. Installs its 14 GTA SA scripts in Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/cleo/ (the .csa ones, such as invincibility and regeneration, always run: delete the ones you don't want).

patches_removed.name: GTA Prop Fix
patches_removed.description: Restores map props missing from the Definitive Edition.

patches_removed.name: Loading Music
patches_removed.description: Plays one of the game's eight loading-screen themes (S_000-S_007) while a save loads, like the PC SALoadingMusic mod.

patches_removed.name: ModMenu
patches_removed.description: In-game settings menu for the other mods.

patches_removed.name: Pak Loader
patches_removed.description: Loads Unreal .pak mod files from Android/data/com.rockstargames.gtasa.de/paks/ when the game starts. They load above the game's own paks, so any file a mod pak contains replaces the game's copy (PC Definitive Edition pak mods work as-is). Copy the .pak files there and restart the game. Ships no game files.

patches_removed.name: Project Props
patches_removed.description: Project Props 4: about 16,000 extra map props. Downloads the Project Props placements from github.com/user-grinch/Project-Props while patching (needs internet).

patches_removed.name: SkyGfx
patches_removed.description: PS2-style graphics: PS2 timecyc, radiosity, distant lamp coronas, post effects.

patches_added.name: Allow landscape
patches_added.description: Lets Messenger turn sideways with your phone, for a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos. It follows your phone's auto-rotate setting. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Restart Messenger after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide chosen chats
patches_added.description: Adds Hide from chat list to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. A hidden chat stays off your chat list when new messages come in, and search still finds it. Hiding stays on this phone, and you can unhide chats in HushMessenger settings. It doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Notify for restricted chats
patches_added.description: Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Preview chats on long press
patches_added.description: Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, AI in search and in @ suggestions, and the offer to summarize a chat's unread messages. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
